title: Add mindensity and maxdensity attributes to img and source
body:
Add `mindensity` and `maxdensity` content attributes (reflected as `minDensity` and `maxDensity` on `HTMLImageElement` and `HTMLSourceElement`) to clamp the target pixel density (`devicePixelRatio`) used when selecting an image source from a source set. Stacked on #13183: - **Content and IDL attributes**: Adds `mindensity` and `maxdensity` to `` and `` (when inside ``), reflected as `minDensity` and `maxDensity` (`DOMString`). Values are parsed using the rules for parsing floating-point number values; non-positive values and parse errors are ignored. - **Per-attribute fallback in ``**: When a `` element is selected in ``, each of `mindensity` and `maxdensity` falls back independently to the corresponding attribute on the `` element if not present on ``. - **Target density clamping**: In *select an image source from a source set*, `targetDensity` starts at `devicePixelRatio`, is clamped to `maximum density` (`min(targetDensity, maxDensity)`), and then to `minimum density` (`max(targetDensity, minDensity)`), so `mindensity` takes precedence if `mindensity > maxdensity` (matching CSS `min`/`max` clamping). - **Relevant mutations**: Setting, changing, or removing `mindensity` or `maxdensity` on `` or a preceding sibling `` in `` triggers *update the image data*. Fixes #4421.
